Changes.note: “Approve” enrols the talebe at once: they reach the sessions and the recordings, a notification tells them, and while the course is published its sessions’ calendar invitations come by e-mail. “Reject” deletes the application; the talebe is notified, no reason is taken, and they may apply again. A rejection is written to the audit log. An approval is not undone here: an enrolled talebe is taken out only from the Enrolled tab, with a reason.
